summary: Native charts without authored titles must explicitly seal has_title false so PowerPoint save-copy/reopen cannot materialize a series name as a title.
invariants: A no-title native chart emits c:autoTitleDeleted val=1 before PowerPoint COM save/reopen.
PowerPoint first-open and reopen chart snapshots remain identical.
forbidden: Do not rely on python-pptx has_title False without explicitly writing the no-title OOXML state.
